final: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id) SELECT oc.account_id, d.A3 AS region, oc.order_count, oc.order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM order_counts) AS difference_from_average FROM order_counts AS oc JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10
